items.detail: Results remain stratified by allocation, workload, and offered rate; no pooled direction is used.
Inference is limited to seed/trace repeats; requests are not treated as independent repeats.
The single GPU, model, and predeclared rate grid are selected deployment conditions.
No post-treatment covariate adjustment or conditioned regression is performed.
Every rate reports the full request denominator and failed-request fraction.
Rates and seeds were frozen before execution rather than selected from extreme outcomes.
The audit requires all 144 samples and retains every failed request as an SLO miss.
The 240 pointwise SLO profile rows are calibration inputs, not claim-level significance tests.
Seeds, rates, thresholds, t critical, and aggregation rules are frozen in the contract.
Allocation is experimentally controlled; claims remain bounded to this deployment matrix.
Precision configuration precedes each serving measurement through a cold-start deployment epoch.

promotion.reason: Calibration passed completeness and analysis gates but uses tuning seeds and has no reproducibility rerun.

statistical_method.bounds: Two-sided 95% Student t interval across the three repeat-level metrics; the lower endpoint is used for SLO-goodput and the upper endpoint for P95 TTFT and P95 TPOT.
statistical_method.exploratory_boundary: Calibration outcomes may choose a selector profile but may not be reported as confirmatory paper effects.
statistical_method.multiple_comparisons: This calibration performs no claim-level significance testing. Bounds are pointwise controller inputs; confirmatory comparisons and multiplicity correction are reserved for disjoint seeds 11, 23, and 47.
statistical_method.request_level_pseudoreplication: Requests are used only to compute each repeat-level metric and are never treated as independent repeats.
